create_mlp_embedding: create an MLPEmbedding instance with a specified embedding dimension and optional MLP layer dimensions
build_mlp_embedding_from_config: build an MLPEmbedding from an MLPFeatConfig object using the from_config class method
run_mlp_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MLP embedding layers on input tensor data
review_mlp_embedding_init: review the MLPEmbedding constructor to understand how MLP layers are built from layer dimensions
refactor_mlp_embedding_layers: refactor the MLPEmbedding MLP layer construction to add custom activation functions or layer types
